hook: Viral claims about Glenn Phillips hitting a 16-ball century against India contradict official New Zealand records.

sections.voiceover: Viral claims about Glenn Phillips hitting a 16-ball century against India contradict official New Zealand records.
Social media posts alleged the New Zealand batter reached 100 runs in just 16 balls. Did Glenn Phillips really set such a record during the match against India?
iVerify debunked these viral claims after checking the official match statistics from the India series.
Phillips actually scored 107 runs off 49 balls during his partnership with Daryl Mitchell in Indore.
Official stats confirm 49 balls were faced, not the 16 balls claimed by viral posts.
